title: Collaborative Knowledge Graph for Humans and AI

content.body: In MemTrace, humans and AI write to the same graph. The graph structure—Edge weights, traversal counts, ratings—reflects what knowledge is actually proven useful, rather than merely recorded. Decay ensures graph honesty: untraversed links naturally fade, while frequently used links are reinforced and persist. Ultimately, this forms a self-organizing knowledge base centered around "knowledge that truly matters".
